records.description: The France Excellence Europa Scholarship Program grants study scholarships to students from the European Union's 26 member states (except France) and the other member states of the Council of Europe who are enrolled in Master's or PhD programmes at French higher education institutions. Nearly 8 calls are opened per year with about 170 places awarded out of roughly 400 applicants, and nearly 1,000 students have been supported since 2006.

records.applicant_utility: Applicant utility (original writing for the France Excellence Europa Scholarship): use the allowance as a predictable half-year top-up of 6,850 euros plus a 1,700 euro installation allowance that matches the French academic rhythm, and note that M1 entrants receive 24 months of support while M2 entrants receive 12. Because course fees and transport are explicitly outside the scholarship and it cannot be combined with any other French government scholarship, treat it as one layer of a wider financing plan rather than the whole budget. Pre-selection happens at the French embassy in your country and the final decision sits with the Ministry, so the file must please two different audiences: local embassy readers and ministerial assessors. Keep timing in mind: with roughly 170 places against about 400 applicants per cycle and nearly eight calls a year, your best odds come from applying in the cycle that immediately follows your enrolment, since enrolment dates before early February drive eligibility.

records.description: The France Excellence Major Scholarship is a French government scholarship within the France Excellence framework. Scholarships are granted across three levels: complementary health cover, taux 1 (280 euros per month) and taux 2 (860 euros per month), plus travel allowance and round-trip air travel at taux 1 or taux 2 (reduced for neighbouring countries). Around 200 new students are selected each year in a total cohort of around 800, and the scholarship can support a maximum of 5 years of study. The 2026 campaign ran from 16 February 2026 to 12 March 2026 on the Cascade platform.
records.number_of_awards: around 200 new scholars per year (about 800 total)

verification.notes: Verified on the official AEFE pages: three levels (health cover, taux 1 at 280 euros per month, taux 2 at 860 euros per month), travel allowance and round-trip travel at taux 1/2 reduced for neighbouring countries, around 200 new and about 800 total scholars, 2026 campaign 16 February - 12 March 2026 on Cascade, commission in May, results in June. The prestations annex PDF is image-based and was not machine-readable, so the monthly figures were taken from the AEFE 'Devenir boursier' page itself.

records.applicant_utility: Applicant utility (original writing for the France Excellence Major Scholarship): understand the rate before you rely on the money - the family-need rated levels are 280 euros per month (taux 1) or 860 euros per month (taux 2), plus round-trip air travel and a travel/housing supplement at the reduced rate for neighbouring countries, and the BGF status that brings social security, priority housing and exemption from student contributions. The scholarship is administered online through the Cascade platform during a single annual campaign (in 2026: 16 February to 12 March), so treat the window as hard. Practically, this award is about stability rather than size: with around 200 new places in a cohort of about 800 and up to five years of study supported, the successful strategy is a steady academic trajectory rather than a last-minute application, and the file must carry a commission sitting in May that will compare you against the full applicant pool.
